A framework by Kegin Hannemann.

---

## Download

The latest version of the Metageometra PDF is always available on the **GitHub Releases page**:

➡️ **[Download latest release](https://github.com/stillsilent22-spec/Metageometra-/releases/latest)**

Each release contains the versioned PDF as an immutable release asset.
**Released versions are permanent** — once published, a release is never modified.
New versions are only published as new releases.

---

## Versioning

- Every new version of Metageometra is published as a new GitHub Release with a version tag (e.g. `v18.0.0`).
- Old releases remain unchanged and accessible at all times.
- Only the author (Kegin Hannemann) publishes new releases.

---

## Citation / DOI

This repository is integrated with [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/) for persistent DOI assignment.
Each GitHub Release automatically receives a citable DOI via Zenodo.

**How to set up Zenodo (one-time, done by repository owner):**
1. Log in at [https://zenodo.org](https://zenodo.org) using your GitHub account.
2. Under *Settings → GitHub*, enable the `Metageometra-` repository.
3. Create a new GitHub Release — Zenodo will automatically archive it and assign a DOI.
4. Copy the DOI badge URL from Zenodo and replace the placeholder badge at the top of this README.

**Once a DOI is available, cite as:**
> Hannemann, K. (*year*). Metageometra (v*X.Y.Z*). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.XXXX/zenodo.XXXXXXX
